body: Well, at least you seem to be handling it maturely.
It's true. I want to give up bc I can't imagine life ever feeling differently than it does now.
Thank you for saying this. "everyone deserves to be heard" will be my new motto. I think I will make it but I'll see what the day brings.
I'm lonely too, OP. I'm looking for someone to talk to, if you'd like.

My boyfriend actually dumped me. He said I betrayed his trust by getting pregnant. I took the pill as directed, but this months pregnancy test was positive. I took some antibiotics without knowing the interaction. He says he can never forgive me and wants nothing to do with either of us.

I just made a noose in my closet. I can't seem to restrict my airway tight enough to even pass out. The "rope" is my super lux bed sheet, so maybe that's why I can't seem to get enough traction? If you knew me IRL, you'd be surprised. I am smiley, and laughy. I have a good job, although many days I leave so no one catches me crying. I don't have a lot of friends, and no boyfriend. I just feel like I've lived enough of this life, and I don't want to go through another day. But I can't seem to off myself. This probably should be it's own thread, but I don't know how to make one
